verdicts.what_would_bite: Narrowly, "REFUSED is fixed" holds: the state enum has all eleven values, Passes.jl:642 writes only `uppercase(String(r.status))` ∈ PASS/FAIL/BROKEN/BLOCKED/REFUSED, and the honored channel (FAVOURABLE = ABSENT, NOT-A-DEFECT, Passes.jl:19/599/611) is unaffected; the "honored unreachable" half is true and recorded as a deferral at docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:2133-2147. What I cannot establish is that the class this id named — tally.schema.json admitting what `grade` writes — is gone, because the sibling field was left as it was: `gbg round grade` on a bug-hunt round with a `kind = "architecture"` finding whose `reproductions/<id>.json` disposition is `fixed` and whose act/architecture verdict is FIXED sets `per_id[id]["act"] = "FIXED"` (Passes.jl:636), which is not in the tally `act` enum, so the validate at Passes.jl:688 throws RoundError and the pass cannot be graded at all. State was widened to admit the values written into it; act was not. That asymmetry sits in the same file, written by the same function, and the ABSENT read that the dismissal leans on covers only the REFUSED half.

verdicts.evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md:2131-2139: "A fix cannot be certified across passes… the only exits are a ledger adjudication or an id left open… The remedy is an instrument change… and is that round's first deferral." Preflight.jl:480 `adjudicated_titles(cfg, ledger) = String[e["reason"] for e in ledger if e["scope"] == "finding"]` — no expiry filter; verify-act.js:52 and panel.js:56 then tell every later reader "Nothing merely FIXED is listed".
verdicts.what_would_bite: Passes.grade rebuilds `entry["act"] => nothing` each pass (Passes.jl:584) and closes honored only on `entry["act"] == "HONORED" && fav` (:611), while pass_scope (:261-267) starts the act range at the last GRADED pass's head, pass_open passes only `"range" => fixrange` (:450), and verify-act.js:74 defines UNDONE as "nothing in the diff addresses this finding". So #7 — whose fix IS in the tree (Release.jl:17-29 cites_round, :64-73) and which the blind reader correctly read ABSENT — can never reach honored, and Passes.close (:911) refuses while it is open. The adjudication taken instead is permanent and mislabels it: Ledger.entries drops expired entries (Ledger.jl:61) but Preflight.adjudicated_titles does not, a finding-scope entry carries `overturn_when` instead of `expires` (Init.jl:216) and Doctor.jl:315 only checks that the key exists, so nothing acts when the recorded overturn condition is met. Reader path that misbehaves: Preflight.render_args → panel.js:56, which tells the next check-consistency searching panel "the owner has ruled these findings NOT to be defects … Do NOT spend a finding on anything they cover", and verify-state.js:45-46 which pre-answers NOT-A-DEFECT — for release()'s closure criterion, a genuine defect that was merely fixed, so a later regression of it is silently suppressed. grade also does `adjudicated += 1` (:615), inflating the adjudicated_share Fleet.jl:112 prints as a cross-round comparable rate.
